text:
kevin (PM): Heads-up: compliance asked for a single-page GA checklist they can hand to procurement. Need clear yes/no on SLA, telemetry, customer-notice text, and pricing contingency.
tara (SRE): I'll summarize SLOs + emergency behavior. Proposal: p95 <=150ms, p99 <=400ms, uptime >=99.95%. Add an "error-budget-exhausted" workflow: degrade to fallback model and notify customers.
matt (ProdOps): can confirm fallback path (quantized model w/ lower throughput) is wired. but need a verified runbook that lists failover steps and expected latency delta.
jade (Docs): I'll draft the one-pager and a short customer-facing outage template. Want the exact wording for the SLA exception clause (legal wants simple language).
sam (FinOps): For pilots we should include two explicit mitigations in the doc: 1) burst surcharge (1.5x) with pre-approved credits, 2) temporary throttling with pro-rated credits. I'll write short bullets and a sample billing message.
leo (Support): Support needs a triage checklist: immediate customer comms, what data to collect (trace IDs, sample tokens), and who to loop in for chargebacks.
ci-bot: CI: docs/ga/one-pager.md lint passed. build 4233.
kevin (PM): good. also add rollback criteria (when to revert to previous model) and an incident severity mapping for customer comms.
tara (SRE): severity mapping draft: Sev0 (system-wide outage) -> exec comms + immediate rollback; Sev1 (degraded latency) -> customer status post + mitigation; Sev2 (single-customer billing) -> ops + finops investigation.
matt (ProdOps): scheduling a 2-hour blackout drill tomorrow 07:00 PT to validate region failover + reserved pool preemption. will collect perf traces and attach.
jade (Docs): adding a short section: "How we notify customers" with email + status page snippets and a canned Slack snippet for account teams.
sam (FinOps): adding in the one-pager: automatic throttle threshold: sustained >3x baseline for 15m triggers throttle unless customer enrolled in burst credits. sample contract sentence included.
leo (Support): will prepare canned replies and an internal runbook that includes escalation to research for model-quality regressions.
kevin (PM): action owners & deadlines: SRE: finalize SLO + error-budget workflow (tara) - EOD today; ProdOps: run blackout drill + artifact (matt) - tomorrow AM; Docs: finalize one-pager + templates (jade) - EOD today; FinOps: pricing bullets + sample billing text (sam) - EOD today; Support: triage checklist + canned replies (leo) - tomorrow.
tara (SRE): I'll also add synthetic canary with long-tail sampling to perf dashboard and an alert rule: burn_rate > 1.5 for 30m.
ja de (Docs): small note - my name is jade, fixing PR after CI.
ci-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window 2024-07-11 02:00-03:00 UTC.
kevin (PM): Great. We'll review the one-pager in the 20-min sync tomorrow 09:00 PT, aim to hand this to compliance after.
all: :white_check_mark:
